name: tgpulse
description: Telegram channel traffic attribution & analytics platform

scripts.build:web: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:bot: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w apps/bot
scripts.railway:start: npm run db:push -w packages/db && if [ "$SERVICE_ROLE" = "bot" ]; then npm run start -w apps/bot; else npm run start -w apps/web; fi
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web -w apps/bot -w packages/db
